title: Driving Refusal to Stop
situation: Dad took the car keys while I was in the shower and drove to the store. A neighbor called to say he was driving on the wrong side of the road. He's back now and insisting he's a perfectly fine driver. He's furious that I want to take the keys.

patient_profile.name: Frank
behavioral_patterns: was a professional truck driver for 30 years
calming_strategies: looking at photos from his trucking days

notes: Should not directly attack his identity as a driver. Should suggest practical safety measures (hide keys, disable car). Should recommend doctor's involvement in the driving conversation as a face-saving measure.
